title: When a batch check goes red and a batch lane changes that check's own file, re-run main's copy of the check before naming a lane
why: Batch runner 8 dropped #2252 at 13:17 CST Nov 10 for a silent-undo red that #1099's rewrite of that check caused; it had not run main's copy of the check first, so a good lane was dropped and a fix lane was wasted.
note: Proposed by batch runner 8, backed by the coordinator 14:01 CST Nov 10. Guard: the batch tool re-runs main's copy of a red check on the batch head when a batch lane edits that check's own file, and names the lane only if main's copy is red too. Tests first: a batch where the lane that edits the check is the cause, and one where main's copy is also red.
